taskPrompt: How does an HTTP request actually flow through this codebase? Walk the reader from the Node HTTP server, through app.handle(), into the router and the middleware stack, out to a route handler, and back out through the response helpers. Also show the error path: when a middleware or handler calls next(err), how does the request reach the default final handler instead of a normal response? Scope: stay inside the request lifecycle (view rendering, static serving and body-parser internals are out of scope except where the request lifecycle calls into them); ground every claim in source under lib/ at the pinned revision and attach inspected sources ranges; Express 5 has no lib/router any more, so say where path matching actually happens; show both the success path and the error path, with the error path visually distinct. Deliverable: a schema v2 Workflow candidate JSON that passes archify finalize workflow.
settings: quality=showcase; schema_version=2; CLI invocation: node <cli>/archify/bin/archify.mjs finalize workflow <candidate.json> <out.html> --quality showcase --json --repo-root <src-express>; repository evidence verified against the pinned checkout; visual-check at 1440x900 and 2048x1320, light and dark
